title: Kingdom of Mann
capsule: As the 'Kingdom of Mann,' the Crovan dynasty's realm centered on the Isle of Man while still holding the northern Hebrides of Skye and Lewis, continuing under kings such as Rognvald Godredsson (r. 1187-1226) and Olaf the Black (r. 1226-1237), whose three sons Harald, Ragnvald and Magnus succeeded one another on the island throne. The line ended with King Magnus Olafsson's death in 1265, whereupon the 1266 Treaty of Perth transferred Man and the Hebrides from Norwegian to Scottish overlordship for a payment of 4,000 marks; a final revolt by Magnus's illegitimate son Guðrøðr was crushed by Scottish forces at Ronaldsway in 1275, ending independent Manx kingship for good.
